title: Counter-attack

D0.outcome: Explains that a counter-attack works only if your own defence is complete and your threats arrive first.

D1.outcome: Counts both sides' move requirements and says 'counter-attack' or 'defend'.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, picks the moment to switch from defence to attack and avoids the half-hearted third option.

D3.outcome: Predicts how one tempo or a bare king reverses a counter-attack, and what material it costs.

misconceptions: The best defence is always attack.
conditions: Your own defence is complete and the opponent's position has weak points or pieces that allow uninterrupted threats.
Switching from passive to active comes when the opponent tries to demolish the whole defensive system.
contrasts: The attack is one move slower, or leaves the king bare.
Neither defending nor attacking decisively (the half-hearted third option).
